code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public List<Integer> selfDividingNumbers(int left,int right){List<Integer>out=new ArrayList<>();for(int x=left;x<=right;x++){int n=x;boolean ok=true;while(n>0){int d=n%10;if(d==0||x%d!=0){ok=false;break;}n/=10;}if(ok)out.add(x);}return out;} }
complexity_reason: Inspect digits one by one; reject a number if a digit is zero or does not divide the number.

title: Flood Fill

Invariant: Remember the starting color and visit only neighboring pixels with that color; avoid revisiting changed cells.
Edge cases: Check empty or singleton inputs where permitted, boundaries, and minimal structures.
code: class Solution { public int[][] floodFill(int[][] image,int sr,int sc,int color){int old=image[sr][sc];if(old==color)return image;int m=image.length,n=image[0].length;java.util.ArrayDeque<int[]>st=new java.util.ArrayDeque<>();st.push(new int[]{sr,sc});image[sr][sc]=color;int[]dr={1,-1,0,0},dc={0,0,1,-1};while(!st.isEmpty()){int[]v=st.pop();for(int k=0;k<4;k++){int r=v[0]+dr[k],c=v[1]+dc[k];if(r>=0&&r<m&&c>=0&&c<n&&image[r][c]==old){image[r][c]=color;st.push(new int[]{r,c});}}}return image;} }
complexity_reason: Remember the starting color and visit only neighboring pixels with that color; avoid revisiting changed cells.

code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String shortestCompletingWord(String licensePlate,String[] words){int[] need=new int[26];for(char c:licensePlate.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).toCharArray())if(c>='a'&&c<='z')need[c-'a']++;String best=null;for(String w:words){int[] have=new int[26];for(char c:w.toCharArray())have[c-'a']++;boolean ok=true;for(int i=0;i<26;i++)if(have[i]<need[i]){ok=false;break;}if(ok&&(best==null||w.length()<best.length()))best=w;}return best;} }

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int minDiffInBST(TreeNode root){List<Integer>v=new ArrayList<>();dfs(root,v);int best=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int i=1;i<v.size();i++)best=Math.min(best,v.get(i)-v.get(i-1));return best;}private void dfs(TreeNode n,List<Integer>v){if(n!=null){dfs(n.left,v);v.add(n.val);dfs(n.right,v);}} }
